name: Valery
source:
Captain of the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url]'s Guard. Why the [url=https://vndb.org/c165578]King[/url] appointed a sergeant to an officer's position is debated. The most common thought, was to humiliate the MC. Valery has a mysterious reputation he keeps hidden from the MC.
